title: Confirming Deactivate saves the edits and shows Part deactivated.
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-DEACT-01), with Sell Price $20.00, is stocked at {Location-A}.
  • The note you will type is {Note-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST retire test).
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Change the Sell Price to 25.00.
  4. Click the Inactive option.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Type {Note-A} in Note (Optional).
  7. Click Deactivate.
  8. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab.
  9. Click the Inactive tab.
  10. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 7: both windows close, and a green message "Part deactivated." appears and goes away on its own.
  • Step 8: the Active tab shows no row.
  • Step 9: the Inactive tab shows one row, {Part-A}.
  • Step 10: Sell Price reads $25.00 (the edit was saved) and the title row pill reads "Inactive".

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S13-R22, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.3 (Save asks first), board 3.4 (Done), board 3.5 (The Inactive tab), 13 Oct copy.
